# Third-party source references

The mapper 1–4 adapter in `src/mappers.js` is based on JSNES 2.1.0,
commit `b8a45d088e922b6abcd87c4eb1b7237919e9d3d2`, downloaded from
https://github.com/bfirsh/jsnes on 2026-11-10.

Reference files: `src/mappers/mapper0.js`, `mapper1.js`, `mapper2.js`,
`mapper3.js`, `mapper4.js`, and scanline IRQ hooks in `src/ppu/index.js`.
JSNES is distributed under Apache License 2.0; a copy is in `LICENSE-JSNES.txt`.
Contributor credits are preserved in `references/jsnes/AUTHORS.md` and copied into the release.

The adapter uses page-index tables instead of JSNES's copy-based loaders.
MMC1 mode changes/reset, both single-screen pages, PRG-RAM protection,
MMC3 aligned bank pairs/mode remapping and MMC3B/C IRQ reload semantics were
implemented explicitly, cross-checked with NESdev documentation and test ROMs.
It does not replace the existing jsnes-lite CPU, PPU or audio core.

The jsnes-lite source remains pinned at
`923d45e04483b7655dbdd91773f74de46c38c661` in `upstream/`.

Public diagnostic ROMs used for validation are from
https://github.com/christopherpow/nes-test-roms,
commit `95d8f621ae55cee0d09b91519a8989ae0e64753b`.
They are test inputs, not embedded in the emulator or redistributed with the release.
The original four smoke ROMs under `tests/roms/` are generated by
`tests/make-smoke-roms.mjs` and contain no commercial game data.
